name: dms
description: Selbst gehostetes, persönliches Informations- und Dokumentenmanagementsystem

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared; s=$?; tsc -p shared/test; g=$?; npm run typecheck -w server; t=$?; npm run typecheck -w web; w=$?; exit $((s+g+t+w))
scripts.test: npm run test -w server; s=$?; npm run test -w web; w=$?; npm test --prefix shared; g=$?; exit $((s+w+g))
scripts.lint:abh: depcruise server/src server/test web/src web/test shared/src shared/test --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ignore-known
scripts.lint:umtragen: eslint --suppress-all --pass-on-unpruned-suppressions . && eslint --prune-suppressions . && depcruise server/src server/test web/src web/test shared/src shared/test --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type baseline --output-to .dependency-cruiser-known-violations.json && node .github/werkzeuge/ausnahmen-zaehlen.mjs
